content:
Alex: starting thread on a 'bitcasting gatekeeper' idea - essentially a safety layer that prevents unsafe cross-bitwidth swaps (eg fp8 -> 4-bit) unless explicit canonicalization has run.
Priya: +1. call out two paths: fast-path bitcast (no artifact change, runtime maps kernels) vs canonicalize (materialize converted tensors with documented quant params).
Jon: fast-path is tempting for rollout speed but we saw subtle numeric shifts in short-span factual tests. how do we gate it?
Sora: propose a gatekeeper policy that requires a quant_compat_score >= 0.92 to allow fast-path. score is computed from per-tensor scale vectors (cosine sim) and a structural check (matching tensor shapes/layouts).
Marta: also require a canonicalization run for any mapping that crosses quant families (FPx -> INTy) unless owner-approved. canonicalization produces artifact and a quant_manifest with per-tensor fingerprints.
Alex: runtime traceability: add header X-bitcast: orig=<orig_profile>;path=<fast|canon>;resolved=<effective_profile>;score=<0.93>. log kernel_id and manifest_hash.
Priya: ops-runbook snippet suggestion:
```
monitor: bitcast_rate, canonicalize_fail_rate, deg_score_delta
if bitcast_rate > 0.5% AND deg_delta > 0.03 -> flip gate -> require canonicalize for that model
on deg spike: enable shadow-canonical run and pause traffic-swap
ramp: canonicalize then traffic-split 2%->10%->50%->100% with warmup_n=5
```
Jon: onboarding lint: block bitcast mappings when profile lacks quant_manifest. Owners must acknowledge risk before enabling fast-path. Also reject wildcard mappings.
Sora: telemetry: add 'bitcast_event' with fields: orig, resolved, path, score, kernel, manifest_hash to logs. Eval pipeline can join by manifest_hash to compute deg_score per path.
Marta: privacy: ensure manifest hashes are non-reversible and sampled according to tenant retention settings. No raw tensor stats in logs.
Alex: edge-case: what about models with dynamic quant params (per-batch scale adaptation)? gatekeeper should treat them as incompatible for fast-path unless a 'stable-seed' run validates compatibility.
Priya: action items: 1) draft gatekeeper policy & schema (Priya) 2) header + event logging patch (Jon) 3) onboarding linter + owner-ack flow (Marta) 4) eval join by manifest_hash and path dim (Sora).
ops-bot: ticket created: BITCAST-GATE-117 assigned to eng-ml.
Jon: I'll put up a tiny PR for the header and event shape today.
Alex: let's keep fast-path opt-in per-model and per-tenant until we have clear deg_score signals. short followup meeting Thursday. :thumbsup:
